name: castle-carpenter-services
reviewNotes: All 20 original glyph records reviewed. Use existing 木匠阿留, 機關村 and 圈地絲 terminology.
Preserve one-time castle relocation, no building over trees or rivers, the unused-thread and full-inventory checks, and the dynamic facility name and price.
Facility descriptions include a doctor, tea shop, cypress bath and battle viewing; text only, with no changes to placement or construction rules.

「木匠阿留，
什麼東西都會做呢！」

「前陣子，他還替我家，
做了間減肥室。
真希望趕快瘦下來呀！」
records.1:
「阿留手藝那麼好，
是因為曾在機關村修行。」

「等我的手藝更好，
也要到海那邊的機關村，
好好修行一番！」

做兩次相同的東西呢！
很厲害吧？！」

records.5:

records.6:

「你應該知道，
